Task: Batch Speech-to-Text

Write code that requests speaker diarization for a recorded meeting using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — AssemblyAI:
  Service: AssemblyAI Transcripts API
  SDK: assemblyai
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: transcripts.submit, transcripts.get
  Setup hints: ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/transcripts/submit

Option 2 — Amazon Transcribe:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_transcription_job, get_transcription_job
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/what-is.html

Option 3 — Watson Speech to Text:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text

Option 4 — Cloud Speech-to-Text:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: long_running_recognize, recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs

Option 5 — Alibaba Model Studio ASR:
  Service: Paraformer / Model Studio ASR
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: Recognition.call, Paraformer
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/speech-recognition

Option 6 — Azure AI Speech:
  Service: Azure AI Speech
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechRecognizer, recognize_once_async
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/speech-to-text

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import os
import sys
import json
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

import boto3


def batch_speech_to_text_with_diarization(
    media_uri: str,
    job_name: str,
    language_code: str = "en-US",
    max_poll_seconds: int = 3600,
    poll_interval_seconds: int = 15,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Start an Amazon Transcribe batch transcription job with speaker diarization
    and poll until completion.

    Args:
        media_uri: Publicly accessible S3 URI or HTTP(S) URL to the audio/video file.
        job_name: Unique transcription job name.
        language_code: BCP-47 language code, e.g. "en-US".
        max_poll_seconds: Maximum time to wait for completion.
        poll_interval_seconds: Poll interval in seconds.

    Returns:
        A dictionary containing job metadata and transcription results.
    """
    client = boto3.client("transcribe")

    start_kwargs: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "TranscriptionJobName": job_name,
        "Media": {"MediaFileUri": media_uri},
        "LanguageCode": language_code,
        "Settings": {
            "ShowSpeakerLabels": True,
            "MaxSpeakerLabels": 10,
        },
    }

    client.start_transcription_job(**start_kwargs)

    deadline = time.time() + max_poll_seconds
    last_response: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None

    while time.time() < deadline:
        resp = client.get_transcription_job(TranscriptionJobName=job_name)
        last_response = resp
        job = resp.get("TranscriptionJob", {})
        status = job.get("TranscriptionJobStatus")

        if status == "COMPLETED":
            transcript_uri = (
                job.get("Transcript", {}).get("TranscriptFileUri")
                or job.get("Transcript", {}).get("RedactedTranscriptFileUri")
            )
            transcript_json: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None

            if transcript_uri:
                import urllib.request

                with urllib.request.urlopen(transcript_uri) as f:
                    transcript_json = json.loads(f.read().decode("utf-8"))

            segments: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
            if transcript_json:
                results = transcript_json.get("results", {})
                items = results.get("items", [])
                speaker_labels = results.get("speaker_labels", {})
                segments = speaker_labels.get("segments", [])

            return {
                "job_name": job_name,
                "status": status,
                "transcript_uri": transcript_uri,
                "job": job,
                "transcript": transcript_json,
                "speaker_segments": segments,
            }

        if status in {"FAILED", "CANCELED"}:
            return {
                "job_name": job_name,
                "status": status,
                "job": job,
                "error": job.get("FailureReason"),
            }

        time.sleep(poll_interval_seconds)

    raise TimeoutError(
        f"Transcription job '{job_name}' did not complete within {max_poll_seconds} seconds. "
        f"Last response: {last_response}"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    media_uri = os.environ.get("TRANSCRIBE_MEDIA_URI")
    job_name = os.environ.get("TRANSCRIBE_JOB_NAME", f"meeting-diarization-{int(time.time())}")

    if not media_uri:
        raise SystemExit("Set TRANSCRIBE_MEDIA_URI to a public media URL or S3 URI.")

    result = batch_speech_to_text_with_diarization(media_uri=media_uri, job_name=job_name)
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
